title: End completed-work reports with explicit user action requirements
summary: When reporting a completed work session or development deliverable, end the summary with a clearly separated user-action section. State each approval, decision, choice or input genuinely needed to proceed, identifying what it unblocks. If no user action is necessary, explicitly state that nothing is required. Keep optional follow-up suggestions distinct from mandatory action, and do not imply that automatic work authorization follows from reporting a possible next step.
